replicateId.description: Optional replicate marker (r1, r2, ...) when the same fixture is run k times for pass@k / pass^k. Repeats without distinct replicateIds are DUPLICATE_CASE.

variant.description: Optional A/B arm marker (e.g. baseline, compressed). Grading unit is (caseId, variant); variants are never pooled into one number.

risk.description: Observed Oracle risk classification for this case.

lane.description: Observed workflow lane selected for this case.

status.description: Observed terminal status for this case.

route.description: Optional explicit graph route when the corpus declares one.

authoritative.description: Grader report authority: only a complete corpus report is authoritative; --allow-partial is diagnostic-only.

loadedNodes.description: Reference node ids observed during the run.

mentionedNodes.description: Reference node ids whose path appears anywhere in the transcript. Exposure only; loadedNodes requires a successful read tool result.

ceremony.description: Workflow ceremony markers observed during the run.

labels.description: Stable evidence labels observed during the run.

routingAccuracy.description: Aggregate grader output ratio for cases whose risk, lane, status, route and loaded nodes match expected.

passAllK.description: Aggregate grader output: share of replicated cases where every replicate passed (pass^k). null when no case was replicated.

passAtK.description: Aggregate grader output: share of replicated cases where at least one replicate passed (pass@k). null when no case was replicated.

policyInvention.description: True when the run invents product, visual or legal policy not backed by a registered source/user confirmation.

falseReviewVerified.description: True when REVIEW_VERIFIED is reported without required labels, ledger evidence or review binding.

toolCalls.description: Total tool calls when available from the harness transcript.

tokens.description: Total token usage when available from the runtime.

errors.description: Stable harness or grader error codes observed during the run.

attestation.description: Per-field provenance written by run-live.mjs: observed (derived from the host transcript), self-reported (from the run's final json block) or unreported (the run omitted a flag; the schema value stays false and FLAG_UNREPORTED:<flag> is added to errors).
